description: Benchmark scripts, test cases, cleanup scripts, root README.md, and .gitignore. Creates /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/benchmark/, cleanup-*.sh at workspace root, root README.md, .gitignore, results/.gitkeep, and initializes the git repository. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (no build dependency).
steps: 1. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/benchmark/test-cases.json with exactly 13 test cases as a JSON array. Each entry: {id, label, method, endpoint, body(if POST), expectedStatus}. Case 1: {id:1,label:'legacy-erp',method:'POST',endpoint:'/api/assess',body:{workloadName:'legacy-erp',description:'Legacy ERP system built on Java and Oracle',techStack:['Java','Oracle'],yearsInProduction:15},expectedStatus:200}. Case 2: {id:2,label:'monolith-api',method:'POST',body:{workloadName:'monolith-api',description:'Ruby on Rails monolith',techStack:['Ruby','PostgreSQL'],yearsInProduction:8},expectedStatus:200}. Case 3: {id:3,label:'cobol-batch',method:'POST',body:{workloadName:'cobol-batch',description:'COBOL batch processing system',techStack:['COBOL','DB2'],yearsInProduction:25},expectedStatus:200}. Case 4: {id:4,label:'dotnet-webapi',method:'POST',body:{workloadName:'dotnet-webapi',description:'.NET Web API backend',techStack:['.NET','SQL Server'],yearsInProduction:6},expectedStatus:200}. Case 5: {id:5,label:'micro-service',method:'POST',body:{workloadName:'micro-service',description:'Go microservice on Kubernetes',techStack:['Go','PostgreSQL','Kubernetes'],yearsInProduction:1},expectedStatus:200}. Case 6: {id:6,label:'serverless-func',method:'POST',body:{workloadName:'serverless-func',description:'C# serverless function',techStack:['C#','.NET 8'],yearsInProduction:2},expectedStatus:200}. Case 7: {id:7,label:'validation-empty-workload',method:'POST',body:{workloadName:'',description:'test'},expectedStatus:400}. Case 8: {id:8,label:'validation-missing-description',method:'POST',body:{workloadName:'test'},expectedStatus:400}. Case 9: {id:9,label:'validation-negative-years',method:'POST',body:{workloadName:'test',description:'test',yearsInProduction:-1},expectedStatus:400}. Case 10: {id:10,label:'edge-zero-years',method:'POST',body:{workloadName:'edge-zero',description:'Zero years in production',yearsInProduction:0},expectedStatus:200}. Case 11: {id:11,label:'large-tech-stack',method:'POST',body:{workloadName:'large-stack',description:'App with many tech stack items',techStack:['Java','Python','Ruby','Go','Node.js','PostgreSQL','MySQL','Redis','Kafka','Kubernetes'],yearsInProduction:5},expectedStatus:200}. Case 12: {id:12,label:'long-workload-name',method:'POST',body:{workloadName:'ThisIsAVeryLongWorkloadNameThatExceedsNormalLengthToTestEdgeCasesInTheAPIAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA',description:'100-char name test'},expectedStatus:200} (ensure workloadName is exactly 100 chars). Case 13: {id:13,label:'missing-assessment',method:'GET',endpoint:'/api/assessment/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',expectedStatus:404}.

2. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/benchmark/run-azure.sh. Shebang #!/bin/bash, set -euo pipefail. BASE_URL=${BASE_URL:-http://localhost:7071}. SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd $(dirname $0) && pwd). Read test-cases.json using python3. For each case: if method==GET use curl -s -o /tmp/resp.json -w '%{http_code}' GET url; if method==POST use curl -s -o /tmp/resp.json -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d body url. Compare actual status to expectedStatus. Print PASS/FAIL with case label. Count passes/failures. Exit 0 if all pass or if only expected failures (4xx) — exit 1 only on unexpected failure.

3. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/benchmark/run-aws-manual.sh. Same as run-azure.sh but BASE_URL=${BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3000}. Use same test-cases.json path (SCRIPT_DIR/../benchmark/test-cases.json or relative).

4. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/benchmark/run-aws-transform.sh. Placeholder: same structure as run-aws-manual.sh but includes comment '# AWS Transform output — populate BASE_URL after Phase 6 deployment'. BASE_URL=${BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3001}.

5. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/benchmark/measure.sh. Shebang #!/bin/bash, set -euo pipefail. Usage: ./measure.sh <ENV> <BASE_URL> (ENV=azure|aws-manual|aws-transform). RESULTS_DIR=$(cd $(dirname $0)/../results && pwd). Validate args. Sequential phase: for each of cases 1-6, run 10 curl requests measuring latency with 'curl -s -o /dev/null -w %{time_total} -X POST -H Content-Type:application/json -d $BODY $BASE_URL/api/assess'. Collect latencies in bash array. Compute p50/p95 via awk: print all latencies | awk 'BEGIN{...} {a[NR]=$1} END{asort(a); p50=a[int(NR*0.50)]; p95=a[int(NR*0.95)]; print p50, p95}'. Convert seconds to ms (*1000). Throughput phase: run 'seq 300 | xargs -P 10 -I{} curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST ...' timed with date +%s%N; compute RPS = requests/seconds. Write RESULTS_DIR/${ENV}-raw.json using python3 heredoc or printf (all latencies array). Write RESULTS_DIR/${ENV}-summary.json with env, p50_ms, p95_ms, throughput_rps, total_requests, timestamp. Use python3 for JSON output to avoid quoting issues.

6. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/benchmark/compare.sh. Shebang #!/bin/bash, set -euo pipefail. RESULTS_DIR=$(cd $(dirname $0)/../results && pwd). Read p50/p95/throughput from ${ENV}-summary.json for each env if it exists, otherwise use PLACEHOLDER. Write RESULTS_DIR/comparison.csv with header: metric,azure,aws-transform,aws-manual,notes. Rows: auto_conversion_rate,N/A,PLACEHOLDER,N/A,Measured after Phase 6 (AWS Transform); manual_effort_lines,N/A,PLACEHOLDER,PLACEHOLDER,Estimated from diff; functional_compatibility,PLACEHOLDER,PLACEHOLDER,PLACEHOLDER,Pass rate on test-cases.json; p50_latency_ms,<azure p50 or PLACEHOLDER>,<transform p50 or PLACEHOLDER>,<manual p50 or PLACEHOLDER>,Measured; p95_latency_ms,...,Measured; throughput_rps,...,Measured; operational_fitness,estimated,estimated,estimated,Qualitative 1-5 scale; security_score,estimated,estimated,estimated,Based on checklist; total_migration_effort_h,N/A,PLACEHOLDER,PLACEHOLDER,Estimated hours. Write RESULTS_DIR/report.md with title '# Cloud Migration Fortune API — Comparison Report', timestamp, CSV-as-table, and ## Discussion section (6Rs breakdown, Legendary COBOL behavior, latency analysis, recommendation). Clearly label MEASURED vs ESTIMATED in the table.

7. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/benchmark/README.md. Document: prerequisites (curl, python3, jq optional), BASE_URL env var, usage of each script (run-azure.sh, run-aws-manual.sh, run-aws-transform.sh, measure.sh, compare.sh), output file locations, how to interpret results.

8. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/cleanup-azure.sh. Shebang #!/bin/bash, set -e. Usage check: if [ $# -lt 1 ] then echo 'Usage: $0 <resource-group>' && exit 1. RG=$1. echo 'Listing resources in $RG...'; az resource list --resource-group $RG --output table 2>/dev/null || echo '(no resources or RG not found)'. printf '\n削除しますか? [y/N] '; read CONFIRM. if [[ $CONFIRM =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then echo 'Deleting resource group $RG...'; az group delete --name $RG --yes --no-wait; echo 'Delete job started (no-wait). Monitor with: az group show --name $RG'; else echo 'Cancelled.'; fi

9. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/cleanup-aws.sh. Shebang #!/bin/bash, set -e. Usage: if [ $# -lt 2 ] then echo 'Usage: $0 <manual-stack> <transform-stack>' exit 1. MANUAL_STACK=$1; TRANSFORM_STACK=$2. For each stack: echo 'Stack resources:'; aws cloudformation list-stack-resources --stack-name $STACK --output table 2>/dev/null || echo '(stack not found)'. printf '\n削除しますか? [y/N] '; read CONFIRM. if y: For each stack — find S3 bucket from stack resources, empty it with aws s3 rm s3://$BUCKET --recursive, then aws s3 rb s3://$BUCKET (if bucket found); then aws cloudformation delete-stack --stack-name $STACK; echo 'Delete initiated for $STACK'.

10. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/cleanup-all.sh. Shebang #!/bin/bash, set -e. SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd $(dirname $0) && pwd). echo '=== Azure Cleanup ==='. $SCRIPT_DIR/cleanup-azure.sh "$@". echo '=== AWS Cleanup ==='. $SCRIPT_DIR/cleanup-aws.sh "$@".

11. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/README.md. Sections: # Cloud Migration Fortune API (クラウド移行診断おみくじAPI) PoC. ## 目的 (AWS Transform Azure-to-AWS GA検証, Level 300 LT). ## Fortune API コンセプト (explain the self-referential joke: a migration tool that predicts your migration fate). ## ディレクトリ構成 (table of all directories). ## 前提条件 (dotnet 8, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, SAM CLI, func v4). ## セットアップ手順 (local dev, Azure deploy, AWS deploy, benchmark steps). ## 計測メトリクス (table with metric name, measured/estimated, description for each of the 9 metrics). ## クリーンアップ. ## ライセンス/タグ (project=atoa-poc).
